# graph-databases

Vendor-neutral graph-database access - Gremlin, openCypher and SPARQL shapes (bounded results, stopped loops, labeled fan-out, anchored starts, bounded paths, parameterized text) measured on data.graph.query facts by model graph-access.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-DATA-013` | medium | Graph traversal/query without a limit |
| `AF-GDB-001` | high | Gremlin repeat() without times() or until() |
| `AF-GDB-002` | medium | Fan-out step without an edge label |
| `AF-GDB-003` | high | Traversal starts from every vertex or edge |
| `AF-GDB-004` | high | openCypher variable-length path without an upper bound |
| `AF-GDB-005` | medium | openCypher MATCH with no label or property anchor |
| `AF-GDB-006` | medium | openCypher disconnected patterns form a cartesian product |
| `AF-GDB-007` | medium | SPARQL property path with + or * and no bound |
| `AF-GDB-008` | medium | Graph query text built by concatenation or interpolation |
| `AF-GDB-025` | low | Executed plan shows a high fan-out ratio |
